scope: Isolated Chromium154 native Blob download/restart diagnostic, without the game or its assets. The source included is the final writable-cache variant; the earlier logs use the same minimal button and restart loop with the options listed below.

variants.name: default
variants.options: Native acceptDownloads true; default Playwright download directory

variants.name: fixed-target
variants.options: Native acceptDownloads true; one explicit downloadsPath shared by both launches

variants.name: writable-cache
variants.options: Shared downloadsPath plus task-owned writable XDG_CACHE_HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME

conclusion: A full browser restart plus new download is blocked by the current system Chromium. It is not counted as a successful game export or hidden-state roundtrip. The production journey uses real exports and reloads in its first process, then a real restart checked via public UI with no subsequent download.
